description.zh:
导播台ID。

- 如果您通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**路径查看导播台名称。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
description.en:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the CasterId value that is returned in the response.

- If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo LIVE console, go to the **ApsaraVideo LIVE console** > **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** page to view the name of the production studio.

> The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the ID of the production studio.

description.zh:
单个节目播放时间长度，单位：秒。
>**RepeatTimes**和**Duration**两者只允许设置其中一个。
description.en:
The playback duration of a single show, in seconds.

> You can set only one of the **RepeatTimes** and **Duration** parameters.

description.zh:
单个节目播放循环次数，默认为0。
> - **RepeatTimes**和**Duration**两者只允许设置其中一个。- RepeatTimes为重复次数，示例：-1表示可无限重复；0表示重复0次（实际播放1次）；1表示重复1次（实际播放2次）；以此类推。
description.en:
The number of times a single show is played in a loop. The default value is 0.

> - You can set only one of the **RepeatTimes** and **Duration** parameters. RepeatTimes specifies the number of repetitions. For example, -1 means the show is played in an infinite loop. 0 means the show is played once (not repeated). 1 means the show is played twice (repeated once).
The ID of the VOD file.

description.zh:
素材类型。取值：
- live：直播素材。
- vod：点播素材。
- pic：图片素材。

>- 使用视频点播（VOD）资源，可优先选择托管Bucket资源，自有Bucket资源存在过期风险，如果您选用自有Bucket资源，需注意资源的有效期时间。- 直播文件可支持直播素材和第三方URL。- 点播文件可支持点播素材、图片素材和第三方URL。
description.en:
The type of the media asset. Valid values:

- live: live stream

- vod: VOD asset

- pic: image

> * When using resources from ApsaraVideo VOD, prioritize resources from hosted buckets. Resources from your own buckets may expire. If you use resources from your own buckets, note their validity period. Live stream files support live stream assets and third-party URLs. VOD files support VOD assets, image assets, and third-party URLs.
The URL of the playback file.

description.zh: 插入到播放列表的位置。位置从0 开始，默认添加到当前节目单的末尾。
description.en: The position in the playlist where you want to insert the show. Positions are indexed from 0. By default, the show is added to the end of the current playlist.

description.zh:
是否批量添加节目到节目单。取值：

- true：批量添加。

- false：单个添加。

>该参数不填，取值为空时，也表示单个添加。
description.en:
Specifies whether to add shows to the playlist in batches. Valid values:

- true: adds shows in batches.

- false: adds a single show.

> If you do not specify this parameter or leave it empty, a single show is added.

description.zh: 需要添加的多个节目资源列表，每个资源都有独立的showName，resourceUrl等参数。
description.en: The list of show resources to add. Each resource has its own parameters, such as showName and resourceUrl.

title.zh: 添加一个节目到节目单

descriptions.zh:
请先创建新播单型导播台，添加新播单型导播台视频资源后再调用本接口添加导播台节目到节目单中。使用API创建导播台，请参见[创建导播台](~~2848009~~)。

每个节目单最多可添加1000个节目。

><notice>

- 使用视频点播（VOD）资源，可优先选择托管Bucket资源，自有Bucket资源存在过期风险，如果您选用自有Bucket资源，需注意资源的有效期时间。

- 导播台素材资源输入请优先选择视频直播和视频点播的资源，若从第三方URL输入资源存在播放失败可能性，需确定资源的质量和有效性。


></notice>

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, you must create a production studio in playlist mode and add video resources to the production studio. Then, you can call this operation to add shows from the production studio to the playlist. To create a production studio using an API, see [Create a production studio](~~2848009~~).

You can add a maximum of 1,000 shows to a playlist.

><notice>

- When you use resources from ApsaraVideo VOD, prioritize resources from hosted buckets. Resources from your own buckets may expire. If you use resources from your own buckets, be aware of their validity period.

- When you add media resources to a production studio, prioritize resources from ApsaraVideo LIVE and ApsaraVideo VOD. If you add a resource from a third-party URL, playback may fail. Ensure that the resource is of high quality and is valid.

></notice>

## QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 10 calls per second per user. API calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. We recommend that you call this operation at a reasonable rate to prevent throttling.
